_evidence: 0x0043f40d (edi = a track-segment record; its caller 0x0043f636 passes lap records base..[0x00866ecc] whose byte +0x73 has bit 1) walks the 0x160-stride segment array at 0x008943a0 with the shared lap/pit advance (lap end [0x00866ecc], wrap by [0x00866ec4] below pit start [0x00891500], clamp below pit end [0x00866ef8]) and walks back with the inverse (wrap forward by [0x00866ec4] under the lap start [0x00891504], clamp at the pit start). Loop 1 (0x0043f433) stops at a +0x73 bit 0x10 (final) or 0x20 record or when edi leaves the lap; loop 2 (0x0043f4b0, after >= 10 steps) retraces loop 1 to its end; loop 3 (0x0043f525) stops at a bit-0x10 record or when +/-word +0x16 minus [0x00627b04] drops below the previous value. So a lap without any 0x10/0x20 record, an incoherent lap/wrap geometry or a car parked at the pit end with [0x00627b04] <= 0 makes the original loop forever (fuzzed geometry faulted/timed out). Domain: one coherent geometry - 16 lap records 0..15 (lap end base+0x1600, wrap 0x1600, lap start base), pit start record 16..20 (16 = lap flows into the pit, otherwise a gap) and pit end 21..24; record 0 always has bit 0x10, so every lap cycle ends; [0x00627b04] is 1..0x100 (static 0x20), so the pit-end clamp ends loop 3. Starts are records 0..23 (pit and gap starts are a superset of the callers' lap starts, needed to reach the pit branches). Every visited record is then 0..23, and 0x0043fab0 also reads the following record, so words +0, +0x16, +0x18 and the flag byte +0x73 of records 0..24 are varied: flags from a list with bit 0x10 or 0x20 in 1/16 each and bit 2 (sign selector) in most, words unconstrained. 0x00627ac0/0x00627abc (static 0x40, read by no other function) are varied over -0x200..0x200. Every pointer stays inside the 25 records, so nothing faults.
